Perfect! After **Qd5+ Rxd5 (either rook) exd5**, Black wins the rook for just a pawn—a full rook up (5 points). This is winning material.

**Best move: Qd5+**

**Main line:** Qd5+ R7xd5 (or R1xd5) exd5, winning a rook for a pawn.

**Motif: fork** (queen attacks both rooks simultaneously; the rook on d7 cannot escape)

**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent moves a rook to attack your piece, scan for checks that also attack the rook itself. Here, Qd5+ forks both White rooks while giving check—White must deal with the check first, but then you capture a rook for free. Always look for moves that do two jobs at once: checks that also threaten material are exceptionally powerful.
